name: Branko One-Ear
description: A speaker who describes an ogre's vermin-infested tenement.

description_citations.text: Bloomburrow Commander: card flavor text (Bloomburrow Commander, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Branko One-Ear, a former guard in the Golgari raid, is found dead behind his tenement with his brain in his lap.
timeline.quote: A tenant found him propped up against the cornerstone in the filthy alley behind his tenement.

citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2012.
